summary: Dịch vụ VPN an toàn sử dụng WireGuard với xác thực Two-Factor Authentication và Single Sign-On.
usecases: Connecting remote employees to internal company networks securely.
Enabling secure access to home lab services from anywhere.
Simplifying Kubernetes cluster communication across distributed nodes.
ideas: Integrate with identity providers like Okta or Azure AD for enterprise SSO.
Develop a mesh networking feature for IoT device clusters.
Create a monitoring dashboard for VPN traffic and connection health.
